cc:Work.dc:title: IBIS 3.0 model structure
cc:Work.dc:description: IBIS 3.0: two canopy layers over fractional snow, six soil layers to 4 m, and optional heat-only bedrock to 12 m. Selected process links show surface physics, vegetation, whole-cell litter/soil carbon, simple crop harvest, fire and diagnostic wetland methane. Crops and wetlands share the soil column. No lateral routing or active nitrogen limitation.
